name: Scenario Definition 2
definition: Characteristics used to describe a hypothetical scenario designed to test the value of a portfolio of financial instruments under such hypothetical scenario. No maximum number of stress items.

ScenarioType.name: Scenario Type
ScenarioType.definition: Indicates whether the scenario is based on a historical event or a hypothetical scenario.

StrategyStressType.name: Strategy Stress Type
StrategyStressType.definition: Indicates how the scenario stresses the curve.

StressItem.name: Stress Item
StressItem.definition: Information relating to at least one major representative product.
